topic: Grouping Operators and Operands for Improved Readability and Maintainability
explanation: C++ operators follow precedence rules, but complex expressions can become difficult to read and understand.  Explicitly grouping operators and operands using parentheses improves readability, reduces ambiguity, and prevents unintended operator precedence issues. This is crucial for maintainability, especially in larger codebases where others may need to understand and modify your code.  It also helps prevent subtle bugs caused by misinterpreting operator precedence.
